_description: Semantic/data breadcrumb contract, derived from real URL nesting (src/app route tree), not invented. This is NOT a UI design - no visual spec here. The point is a single trail-data function each page family can call once, so the visible breadcrumb component (a future design deliverable) and the BreadcrumbList JSON-LD (see structured-data-contract.json) both read from the same source and can never drift apart.
designNote: None of the route families in this site currently render a real structured breadcrumb component - what exists today (calculator-detail, ab-test-library-detail, journey-library-detail) is a single 'back' link (an ArrowLeft + one label pointing at the immediate parent index), not a multi-level trail. This contract defines the FULL trail each page could show; a future design pass decides how much of it to render visually (the existing back-link pattern may be kept for 1-level-back UI while the JSON-LD carries the full trail - that's a legitimate design choice this file doesn't preempt).

ab-test-library-index.note: Nested under the product page in the trail, matching the real URL nesting (/lab/ab-testing/library)

ab-test-library-detail.trail: [{ Home, / }, { Lab, /lab }, { A/B Test Playbook, /lab/ab-testing }, { A/B Test Library, /lab/ab-testing/library }, { <record's own label>, /lab/ab-testing/library/{slug} }]
ab-test-library-detail.labelSource: the record's seoTitle (English, short) is a better breadcrumb-crumb label than the raw Turkish question (r.question) - unlike H1, a breadcrumb crumb should stay short and match the page's own <title> register, so this is the one place seoTitle should be reused as the leaf label even though H1 uses r.question.

journey-library-index.note: No separate product/marketing page exists for journeys the way ab-testing has one - the library IS the entry point, so it nests directly under Lab, not under an intermediate product page.

journey-library-detail.labelSource: journey.name (already short and unique, works as both H1 and breadcrumb leaf)

journey-merged.trail: same shape as journey-library-detail, but the leaf points at the SURVIVOR's own slug/name (matching this family's canonical rule) - not the retired id
journey-merged.note: Low priority since this page is noindex; included for completeness/consistency only.

calculator-detail.labelSource: spec.name (the catalog's own short tool name, same string already used for the H1 fallback and the index/related-card labels per CalculatorRoutes.tsx's own documented convention) - NOT content.seo.heroTitle or content.seo.seoTitle, to stay consistent with the one existing convention this codebase already has for 'every non-H1 reference to a calculator uses spec.name'.

utility.note: Same trail shape as calculator-detail, even though utility tools aren't calculators - they share the route family and the index page they're listed on.

breadcrumbListStructuredDataMapping: Each trail entry above maps 1:1 to a schema.org BreadcrumbList itemListElement: { '@type': 'ListItem', position: <1-indexed>, name: <trail entry's name>, item: `${SITE_URL}${trail entry's path (or the TR-prefixed path on the TR route)}` }. This is a pure data transform of the same trail array - no separate authoring needed once the trail-producing function exists.
